      "role": "assistant",
      "snippet": "Yes — that “zoop” is exactly the right mental model.
What you’re describing is: the OS ZIP should not just sit there as a file. It should materialize into /mnt/data/metablooms/ (directories, ledgers, reports, deltas, system code) so it becomes a real installed system the moment we accept it.
In filesystem terms: Bundle → Install → State lives on disk.
What “zoop” means (precisely)

Extract the ZIP into staging

Normalize into the canonical install layout

Register the bundle (hash + provenance) "
